tools.name: search_listings
tools.description: Find rentable spaces in a Mexican city by space type. Space types: self-storage (mini bodegas, B2C personal storage), parking (estacionamiento), warehouse (bodega comercial, B2B), industrial-warehouse (nave industrial). Returns up to 5 listings with short URLs to spotme.mx; if none match, returns be

tools.name: get_city_overview
tools.description: Summary of SpotMe inventory in a Mexican city: counts by space type, top neighborhoods, and price ranges. Falls back to benchmark ranges for cities where SpotMe is still expanding. Use this when the user wants a market overview.

tools.name: get_pricing_guide
tools.description: Estimated monthly price range (MXN) for a given space type (self-storage, parking, warehouse, industrial-warehouse) in a Mexican city, optionally narrowed by target size in m². Pure benchmark/reference — does not return individual listings. Use this for "how much does X cost in Y?" questions.

tools.name: get_listing_summary
tools.description: Look up a single SpotMe listing by its short ID (the part after `spotme.mx/c/` in the URL). Returns size, price, neighborhood, and a link back to spotme.mx. Use when the user provides a specific SpotMe link or short ID.
